items.label: Qualcomm Snapdragon Summit Day 1 2026 (09-23-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Data-center AI software after the Modular acquisition (Chris

set.signal: Data-center AI software after the Modular acquisition (Chris Lattner, EVP of Advanced AI Software, who joined Qualcomm through the acquisition of Modular): Modular's unified stack (Mojo, MAX, Modular Cloud) now supports 'six different major architectures from six different hardware vendors', including data-center special-purpose accelerators; Modular has been 'bringing the stack to the Qualcomm Dragonfly family of data center accelerators', built on Qualcomm's NPU platform, and 'showed how we can deliver industry-leading performance on the system'. The stack is 'serving trillions of tokens in productions every few days'; Mojo 1.0 was released last month as production-ready and open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license. Qualcomm is now bringing the Modular platform to its entire portfolio, including Snapdragon, and is partnering with Microsoft to deepen support for the Modular stack on Windows.

items.reason: 'native Mojo' support on Windows was stated by Microsoft's Logan Iyer, not a Qualcomm speaker; Lattner said only that Qualcomm partners with Microsoft to deepen support for the Modular stack on Windows
items.evidence: We are very excited to partner with Microsoft to deepen our support for the Modular stack on the Windows platform.

items.label: Vicor press release: Vicor Corporation Raises Q3 2026 Revenue Guidance (09-30-2026)
items.signal_prefix: On September 30, 2026 Vicor raised its Q3 sequential growth

set.signal: On September 30, 2026 Vicor raised its Q3 sequential growth guidance from more than 20% to more than 30%, in view of increased royalties from the previously announced first non-exclusive license to Vertical Power Delivery (VPD). The licensee is not named and no dollar figure is given.

items.reason: 'again' is not in this release (it is inferred from the separate 09-21 release); the release states only the raise from more than 20% to more than 30%
items.evidence: On September 30, 2026 , Vicor raised its Q3 sequential growth guidance from more than 20% to more than 30% in view of increased royalties
